title: Underneath the Numbers: Quantitative and Qualitative Gender Fairness in LLMs for Depression Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating depression prediction performance differences between male and female participants using quantitative group fairness metrics (Statistical Parity, Equal Opportunity, Equalised Odds, Equal Accuracy) under baseline, gender-explicit, and gender-implicit prompt conditions, and conducting a qualitative fairness evaluation by prompting LLMs to evaluate the gender fairness of their own prediction explanations, analyzed via natural language metrics and thematic analysis.
